title: Vancouver PD website features Quick Escape button that wipes itself from history
ai_summary:
• Vancouver Police Department website introduces 'Quick Escape' button for online safety.
• The button automatically deletes browsing history for added security.
• The feature aims to protect users from potential online harassment.
student_angle: Learn about user interface design and online security best practices, a valuable skill in the tech industry.

title: TS-2026-009: Insecure argument handling in Tailscale SSH permitted root access
ai_summary:
• Tailscale SSH suffered a vulnerability due to insecure argument handling, granting root access.
• Users with vulnerable systems are advised to upgrade or update Tailscale immediately.
• A fix has been released by the Tailscale team, addressing this significant security issue.

title: Jurassic Park computers in excruciating detail
ai_summary:
• IBM and Microsoft used custom-built computers for dinosaur research in the 1993 film Jurassic Park.
• These supercomputers are central to the park's theme and were an innovation at the time.
• The machines are a representation of early 90s computing power with several 68030 processors.
student_angle: Learning how early supercomputers were used can spark ideas for future software projects, but it's not a key skill.

title: Bonsai 27B: A 27B-Class model that runs on a phone
ai_summary:
• Bonsai 27B is a 27B-Class model that can run on a standard smartphone, revolutionizing AI on-the-go.
• This breakthrough is achieved through Bonsai's lightweight architecture and optimized algorithms.
• Bonsai 27B enables mobile devices to support complex AI tasks, opening new possibilities for edge computing.
student_angle: Learn Bonsai 27B as it may open new opportunities in mobile AI development and edge computing.

title: Dependabot version updates introduce default package cooldown
ai_summary:
• Dependabot introduces a default package cooldown feature to prevent rapid version updates.
• This feature aims to reduce package security risks and improve overall application stability.
• Users can still customize cooldown periods to suit their specific needs and workflows.

title: Solving 20 Erdős Problems with 20 Codex Accounts Running in Parallel
ai_summary:

ai_summary:

title: Cursor 0day: When Full Disclosure Becomes the Only Protection Left
ai_summary:
• A 0day vulnerability in Cursor library left users exposed to attacks, prompting a full disclosure.

• The incident highlights the importance of prompt, transparent disclosure in the face of potential security threats.
student_angle: Learning about cursor vulnerabilities can help you better understand secure coding practices and potential risks.
